mapper.sql: SELECT i.id,i.agent_id,a.agent_name,i.product_model_id,m.model_name,i.intent_qty,i.status,i.expire_time,i.remark,i.created_at FROM bike_agent_purchase_intent i JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=i.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=i.product_model_id
mapper.select: i.agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_agent_purchase_intent i i.agent_id=#{agentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_inventory_lock l JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=l.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=l.product_model_id WHERE l.agent_id=#{agentId} AND l.product_model_id=#{modelId} AND a.status='ENABLED' AND m.enabled=1 AND l.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND l.expire_time > NOW(3) AND l.lock_qty > l.released_qty + l.converted_qty
SELECT id FROM bike_agent_purchase_intent WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
